title: Finance — what they may and may not do in Sales

steps.do: Open Left menu → Sales and each tile in turn: Leads, Opportunities, Inquiries, Quotes, Quote templates, Pre-order checklist, Project costing, Approvals, Pipelines & funnels, Set up Sales.
steps.expect: Opens exactly what the matrix allows; anything else is refused with a sentence (never a blank page or an error).
steps.observed: Leads: refused ("Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission to open Leads & pip") [no tile — address typed]; Opportunities: refused ("Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission to open Leads & pip"); Inquiries: refused ("Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission to open CRM — Inqui") [no tile — address typed]; Quotes: opens; Quote templates: refused ("You cannot manage CRM templates.") [no tile — address typed]; Pre-order checklist: refused ("You cannot configure the pre-order checklist.") [no tile — address typed]; Project costing: opens; Approvals: opens [no tile — a
steps.note: The Sales page shows Finance tiles that then refuse: Opportunities, Pipelines & funnels (drawn on opp_can_view()/pipe_can_view(), which accept Quotes view, while the screens need Leads view).

steps.do: Try what the permission matrix says they may do: Read quotations, register contracts, edit contract figures (as amendment), read client register.
steps.observed: Read the quotation; registered AHM/C/2026-27/00001 ("Contract AHM/C/2026-27/00001 registered — it is waiting for …"); the new value went in as an amendment waiting for signatures ("Amendment requested — value ₹94,400 → ₹1,14,400. It needs two signatures — first…", value still 94400); the client register opens.

steps.do: Try what the matrix says they may NOT do: Create quotations, mark accepted/lost, work leads.
steps.expect: Each is refused (button absent, or a refusal sentence when the address is typed).
steps.observed: no "+ New quote"; /quote-new → "You cannot create or edit quotations."; no Mark accepted / Mark lost; a re-sent accept form → "Only the person assigned to this quote (Test BDM) can record the client's answer."; Leads → "Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission to open L"

steps.do: Type the address of a refused screen directly.
steps.expect: Refused the same way — hiding the button is not enough.
steps.observed: /lead-new → "Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission to o"; /opportunities → "Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission to o"; /inquiry-new → "Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission to o"; /quote-edit?id=2 → "You cannot create or edit quotations."; /sales-setup → "Only someone who may change the Sales settings can answ"; /pipelines → "Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission to o"
